summary: Frontend E2E of new Office 'Generate Proposed Sketch' feature. Discovered and fixed a stale node_modules copy of @roofspan/roof-sketch-core that was missing the new generateSketchGeometry.js module — the imported symbol was undefined at runtime causing 'TypeError: generateSketchGeometry is not a function' the moment the user clicked Generate. After copying the fresh package files into /app/frontend/node_modules/@roofspan/roof-sketch-core and restarting the frontend, ALL core generate/adopt/cancel/save lifecycle checks PASSED against a real Owner-logged UI on the deployed preview URL. Seeded a High-Confidence rectangle facet (20x20 @ 6/12, 400 SF) on lead e7b41ad7 and drove the full flow: Generate → High confidence proposal panel with meas_used='1 planes · 0 roof lines', use enabled, geometry rendered → Cancel restored exact state (badge='Saved', proposal-panel gone, gen-btn back) → Regenerate → Use adopted (panel closed, badge='Unsaved changes', save enabled, ZERO network writes on Generate or Use) → Save Sketch (PUT /api/measurements/{rev}/sketches/{struct} → 200, badge='Saved') → Reopen editor showed 'Edit Roof Sketch' and generate-proposed-btn is correctly hidden (saved-sketch guard). Measurement reference values (sketch-meas-plane-*) are byte-identical before Generate and after Use+Save (F1 6/12 · 400 SF (20×20)). Did NOT exercise Needs Review / Insufficient Information branches or the locked-revision read-only case — noted below.

ui_bugs.issue: Stale node_modules copy did NOT include the new generateSketchGeometry export; clicking Generate Proposed Sketch produced an uncaught TypeError overlay and the proposal panel never rendered. Root cause: yarn v1 'file:' protocol copies files at install time; the packages/roof-sketch-core/ source added generateSketchGeometry.js AFTER the last yarn install, so /app/frontend/node_modules/@roofspan/roof-sketch-core/index.js was still exporting the older API. Fixed inside test env by copying packages/roof-sketch-core over the node_modules copy and restarting the frontend (webpack cache cleared).

action_items: Persist the packages/roof-sketch-core install: run `cd /app/frontend && yarn install --force` (or replace the 'file:' dep with a workspace: symlink) so future yarn installs pick up the current package contents. Otherwise the node_modules copy will drift again and Generate will break in production builds.

Not tested this iteration (out of scope for available seed data): (a) 'Needs review' path with unresolved_planes/ambiguity display, (b) 'Insufficient information' path with generate-use-btn DISABLED, (c) Locked/read-only revision hides generate-proposed-btn (data-testid='sketch-readonly-badge' present). Recommend adding fixtures that seed measurement revisions in these three shapes so E2E can cover them next iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: RoofSketchEditor.jsx:99-124 correctly gates canGenerate = !readOnly && save.serverVersion == null && isEmptyDoc && !proposal — verified in UI: after Save Sketch (serverVersion becomes non-null) the button disappears on reopen; and when structure has no saved sketch and canvas is empty it appears.

generateProposed captures preGenRef = { doc, save } BEFORE running geometry generator; cancelProposed restores both via hist.reset+commitSaveState — verified badge returned to 'Saved' after Cancel (save-state rewound cleanly).

Verified: Generate and Use fire ZERO backend writes (network log empty). Only the explicit Save Sketch triggers PUT /api/measurements/{rev}/sketches/{structure}. Measurements panel values (sketch-meas-plane-*) are identical before/after, confirming generation never mutates Measurements.

Package hygiene: /app/packages/roof-sketch-core/index.js correctly exports generateSketchGeometry (line 50). Root workspaces list in /app/package.json declares 'packages/*'. The failure was purely a stale copy in frontend/node_modules — recommend switching /app/frontend/package.json line 34 dep '@roofspan/roof-sketch-core: file:../packages/roof-sketch-core' to a workspace-managed symlink (yarn workspaces resolution) so hot changes reflect immediately.
updated_files: /app/frontend/node_modules/@roofspan/roof-sketch-core/ (replaced with fresh copy of /app/packages/roof-sketch-core; internal node_modules removed) — this is a test-env fix only; main agent must ensure yarn install picks it up permanently.

success_rate.frontend: 6/9 scenarios verified (T1 gating, T2 High Confidence, T5 Cancel, T6 Use, T7 Save + reopen hides button, measurements unchanged). 3/9 not exercised (Needs Review, Insufficient Information, Locked revision) due to unavailable seed data.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The Generate feature works end-to-end after the node_modules fix. Repro seed: use owner login, open lead e7b41ad7-cc50-4a56-ae70-30558c974c4a — its worksheet already has the TestGenHC structure with a rectangle facet; the sketch for that structure is now SAVED so opening it shows 'Edit Roof Sketch' with NO generate-proposed-btn (that alone verifies the saved-sketch guard). To retest the Generate flow, either (a) create another draft revision with a NEW un-sketched structure, or (b) POST a new /api/measurements with a fresh structure+facet like the payload used in this iteration. For Needs Review / Insufficient Info: create measurement revisions with 2+ facets missing shared-edge info (needs_review) or facets lacking both width/length and area (insufficient_information). For read-only: transition a revision to 'locked' via POST /{id}/status. Do NOT re-yarn-install without also copying the packages copy afterwards, or the stale-node_modules bug will return.
rca of the issue: Cause: yarn v1 'file:' dependencies are installed by copying files into node_modules at install-time; they are NOT symlinks. When generateSketchGeometry.js was added to /app/packages/roof-sketch-core/ AFTER the last `yarn install`, the copy in /app/frontend/node_modules/@roofspan/roof-sketch-core/ remained stale (missing generateSketch.js and generateSketchGeometry.js, and missing the two new module.exports entries in index.js). The RoofSketchEditor imports generateSketchGeometry from '@roofspan/roof-sketch-core'; at bundle time this resolves to the stale node_modules copy where the symbol is undefined. First invocation (clicking Generate Proposed Sketch) throws 'TypeError: generateSketchGeometry is not a function' and the CRA runtime error overlay appears. Mitigation applied here: rm -rf frontend/node_modules/@roofspan/roof-sketch-core && cp -r packages/roof-sketch-core frontend/node_modules/@roofspan/ && rm -rf that/node_modules && supervisorctl restart frontend (also wiped node_modules/.cache). Permanent fix (main agent): run `yarn install --force` in /app/frontend after any change to /app/packages/*, OR convert the file: dep to a proper workspace symlink.
